narratives.Description: process(design-critique): default arc to yolo no-ingest + recommended Dual-stop; add ingest and noyolo
narratives.Overview:
1. **Closed spend recommendation source.** Before Stop 1, parent records a closed line `spend-recommend: N=1` or `spend-recommend: N≥3` (same closed spend classes as today). That line is the Dual-stop recommendation input. On a bare arc launch with no `n=` / `panel` token, `parseOperatorSpend` / `evaluateSpendRecord` resolve spend from that recorded `spend-recommend:` value and Stop 1 records `spend:` plus `spend-ask: resolved`. Explicit `n=1` / `n=3` / `n≥3` still override. Ambiguous mixes still ask. ⊗ Treat silence as hard-coded N=1. ⊗ Resolve spend from issue/comment/skill English. Wire the recommend field into spend.ts (+ tests) and recut Spend (#4705) contract / content-contract locks that currently require a missing-token ask whenever no utterance token is present.

2. **Run posture default.** Generalize missing-token → `arc-mode: no-ingest` for all hosts (expand / skill-route through `resolveArcRunPostureForHost` semantics). Checkout tokens still win. Ambiguous mixes still ask. Recut contract/skill “else ask” pointers and fixtures that require an unconditional missing-posture ask.

3. **`ingest` opt-out.** Closed launch-utterance token `ingest` resolves to checkout posture only. Never write `arc-mode: ingest`. Keep Direct EXIT / completed-arc `task issue:ingest` as a later separate verb. Recut `ingest-is-not-posture` ask path and ⊗ Front-door mode `ingest` together with fixtures so the opt-out is real without collapsing arc-mode into ingest clearance.

4. **`noyolo` + default yolo-standing.** Bare arc defaults `yolo-standing:` on, treated as equivalent to a closed `yolo` token for the all-accept confirm conjunct only. Closed token `noyolo` clears standing (operator confirm/amend required). Leftover-split consent, pain coverage, and Handoff stay outside that conjunct (unchanged non-goals). Add parser + fixtures; skill pointer names the default and the two opt-outs.

5. **Surfaces.** `content/contracts/design-critique.md` (Run posture, Spend, Yolo standing); `packages/core/src/design-critique/run-posture.ts` (+ tests); `packages/core/src/design-critique/spend.ts` (+ tests); yolo-standing/`noyolo` parse (new or adjacent module); `content/skills/deft-directive-design-critique/SKILL.md` / pack source; content-contract / fixture locks.

6. **Non-goals.** Do not auto-ingest after ingest-ready. Do not change leftover-split consent. Do not replace Dual-stop or pain-audit gates. Do not hard-code silence as N=1 when `spend-recommend:` is N≥3.

## Spend default has no closed Dual-stop recommendation source
blocks-the-design
Evidence: At the pin, `packages/core/src/design-critique/spend.ts` exports only closed `n=1` / `n=3|n>=3|n≥3` / bare-`panel` parsing; `parseOperatorSpend("arc no-ingest yolo 4690")` is ask/`missing-token` in `spend.test.ts`; `evaluateSpendRecord` refuses missing-token with `asked: false` even when Stop 1 already records `spend: N=1`; content-contract `design_critique_contract.test.ts` locks “Do not copy `resolveArcRunPostureForHost` onto spend” and “⊗ Treat silence as N=1”. `leftover-pain.ts` `dualStopSpendSeats` maps an already-resolved spend to seat counts and does not publish a Dual-stop recommendation. No `recommend` path exists in `spend.ts`.
Failure mode: Binding “missing spend → agents’ Dual-stop recommendation” with `spend-ask: resolved` either hard-codes silence as N=1 (forbidden by contract and by this issue’s own non-goal when the published recommendation is N≥3) or treats parent/current-state English as the spend field (contract already classifies issue/comment/skill English as data).
Disposition: Name a closed, non-English recommendation input the parser/fixture can consume before the spend half of the desired flip can bind. Until then, the spend clause of the refutation target stands.

## Missing posture ask is already host-defaulted on grok-bot
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `resolveArcRunPostureForHost` in `run-posture.ts` resolves missing-token to `no-ingest` when `grokBotDetected` is true; `run-posture.test.ts` locks that path and keeps ask when detect is false. `parseOperatorRunPosture("arc 1234 yolo")` still returns ask/`missing-token`. Skill pointer still says “Run posture: parse closed tokens; else ask.” This seat’s launcher is grok.
Failure mode: Stating the target as an unconditional “missing run-posture … must ask before Stop 1” overstates the live gate on grok-bot hosts and hides that the issue’s bare-arc no-ingest default is an expansion of an existing host resolver, not a new posture concept.
Disposition: Recut the posture half of the target and the Bound remedy around generalizing (or skill-routing through) `resolveArcRunPostureForHost`, with checkout tokens still winning and ambiguous mixes still asking.

## Front-door ingest forbid protects arc-mode ≠ issue:ingest
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `parseOperatorRunPosture` returns ask/`ingest-is-not-posture` for bare `ingest`; `ARC_RUN_POSTURES` is only `no-ingest` | `checkout`; `arcModeRecordLine` documents never writing `arc-mode: ingest`; Stop 1 contract locks “⊗ Front-door mode `ingest`”; content-contract test asserts that string; Direct EXIT / skill EXIT still name `task issue:ingest` as a later verb after the completed-arc record.
Failure mode: Admitting launch-utterance `ingest` → checkout without scoping collapses the word that means the later ingest verb into a posture opt-out, so a Bound remedy that only deletes the forbid can reintroduce `arc-mode:` as ingest clearance.
Disposition: Keep arc-mode ≠ `issue:ingest`. If `ingest` becomes the closed checkout opt-out, bind it as Stop 1 launch-parse only, keep Direct EXIT as a separate later verb, and recut the `ingest-is-not-posture` / front-door locks together with fixtures.

## Default yolo-standing arms the confirm conjunct without a closed token
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Operator-verbs contract text: yolo standing on the launching utterance is the confirm conjunct for a posted all-accept successor map; parse yolo as a closed token with word boundaries on the operator chat utterance only. `run-posture.ts` / `spend.ts` contain no yolo-standing / `noyolo` parser. Skill lists yolo as standing confirm, not a missing-token default. `evaluateYoloStandingLeftoverScope` in leftover-pain consumes standing as confirm scope, not as spend.
Failure mode: Bare `arc <N>` defaulting yolo-standing without an utterance token silently replaces the operator confirm/amend offer on all-accept maps; `noyolo` is the only proposed off switch and does not exist yet.
Disposition: Bound remedy must treat default standing as equivalent to a closed `yolo` token for the confirm conjunct, require a real `noyolo` parse, and keep leftover-split / pain / Handoff outside that conjunct (unchanged non-goals).

## Refutation target survival
Partial. The spend clause (“missing spend must not resolve from the agents Dual-stop recommendation”) survives at this pin because no closed Dual-stop recommendation source exists to resolve from. The absolute missing-posture ask does not survive as stated on grok-bot hosts. The bare-ingest forbid survives as the arc-mode ≠ `issue:ingest` separation and does not survive as an unscoped absolute token ban if checkout opt-out is the closed meaning. Yolo-as-opt-in survives as today’s confirm-conjunct gate until default standing plus `noyolo` are explicitly bound.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

Flip the design-critique arc skill front door so a bare `arc <N>` (or equivalent trigger) defaults to **yolo + no-ingest + Dual-stop spend = the agents' published recommendation** for that issue shape. Today those three axes still ask (or require opt-in tokens) before Stop 1.

Add two closed opt-out parameters on the launching utterance:

- `ingest` — leave the no-ingest default
- `noyolo` — leave yolo standing

## Current behavior (problem)

From `content/contracts/design-critique.md` Run posture (#4072 / #4296) and Spend (#4705), plus `parseOperatorRunPosture` / `parseOperatorSpend`:

- Missing run-posture token asks before Stop 1 (`arc <N> yolo` still asks).
- Bare `ingest` asks (`ingest-is-not-posture`); contract forbids a front-door mode named `ingest`.
- Yolo is standing only when the operator says `yolo`; it does not pick posture or spend.
- Missing spend token asks before Stop 1 even when the parent already has a Dual-stop recommendation (N=1 vs N≥3) for the issue shape.
- Silence must not resolve to N=1; there is no "use recommended N" closed default.

Operator habit is already "no-ingest yolo" plus "use recommended n". The skill still makes every arc restate those three tokens.

## Desired behavior

On a bare arc launch (no posture / yolo / spend tokens):

1. **Run posture** defaults to `arc-mode: no-ingest` (github-only dest via `ensureArcDest`; parent stays read-only / unclaimed).
2. **Yolo standing** defaults on (`yolo-standing:` recorded on Stop 1). Same confirm-conjunct semantics as today's explicit `yolo` (all-accept map confirm only; still does not confirm leftover splits, waive pain, or auto-ingest).
3. **Spend** defaults to the **agents' Dual-stop recommendation** for that issue (the same N the parent would print in today's spend-ask). Record `spend:` and `spend-ask: resolved` from that recommendation. Explicit `n=1` / `n=3` / `n≥3` still override when present.

### New closed parameters

| Token | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `ingest` | Opt out of the no-ingest default. Resolve to checkout posture (mutating checkout path). Recut today's ask-on-`ingest` / ⊗ front-door-mode-`ingest` rules so this is a real closed opt-out. Still does not mid-arc auto-run `task issue:ingest`; Direct EXIT / completed-arc ingest remains a separate later verb unless the operator names it after the record. |
| `noyolo` | Opt out of default yolo standing. Operator confirm/amend stays required for bind / path-1 confirm conjunct. |

Affirmative tokens that already resolve no-ingest (`direct`, `github-only`, `no-ingest`, …) and `checkout` stay valid. Ambiguous combinations still ask.

## Bound surfaces

- `content/contracts/design-critique.md` — Run posture + Spend + Yolo standing sections; reverse missing-token-ask defaults; admit `ingest` / `noyolo` closed tokens; keep Direct EXIT ingest as a later verb.
- `packages/core/src/design-critique/run-posture.ts` (+ tests) — default missing → no-ingest; `ingest` → checkout; keep ambiguous asks.
- `packages/core/src/design-critique/spend.ts` (+ tests) — missing spend → recommended Dual-stop class (wire or document the recommendation source the parent already uses); do not treat silence as hard-coded N=1.
- Yolo standing parse (wherever the closed `yolo` token is matched) — default on; add `noyolo`.
- `content/skills/deft-directive-design-critique/SKILL.md` / pack source — pointer that bare arc inherits these defaults; name the two opt-outs.
- Content-contract / fixture locks that currently require missing-token asks or forbid front-door `ingest`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Bare `arc <N>` (or skill trigger with only an issue id) records `arc-mode: no-ingest`, `yolo-standing:`, and `spend:` equal to the agents' Dual-stop recommendation without a posture/spend/yolo ask before Stop 1.
- [ ] `arc <N> noyolo` clears yolo standing and keeps no-ingest + recommended spend unless overridden.
- [ ] `arc <N> ingest` resolves checkout posture and keeps default yolo + recommended spend unless overridden.
- [ ] `arc <N> ingest noyolo n=3` (and other explicit mixes) honor each closed token; ambiguous mixes still ask.
- [ ] Explicit `n=1` / `n=3` / `n≥3` override the recommendation.
- [ ] Completed-arc Direct EXIT still names `task issue:ingest` as a later operator verb; default no-ingest does not auto-ingest.
- [ ] Contract, parsers, skill pointer, and fixtures agree; no silent N=1 when the published recommendation is N≥3.

## Non-goals

- Auto-ingest after ingest-ready chip.
- Changing leftover-split consent (yolo still does not confirm leftover filing).
- Replacing Dual-stop or pain-audit gates.
